subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should ClawHub establish this root-exported version 1 registry bridge before the account/publisher feed model and an OpenClaw consumer have landed?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but automation cannot decide when to freeze a cross-project schema or whether catalog-feed projection is the intended permanent source model.

options.title: Validate Consumer First
options.body: Keep the bridge internal or deferred until the canonical feed model and an OpenClaw consumer prove the fields, identities, and versioning boundary.

options.title: Approve Version 1 Now
options.body: Accept this schema as the supported first contract, then require a clean rebase and consumer-side smoke proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Standalone Bridge
options.body: Close or defer this PR if no near-term OpenClaw consumer owns the contract.

recommendation.title: Validate Consumer First
recommendation.body: Keep the bridge internal or deferred until the canonical feed model and an OpenClaw consumer prove the fields, identities, and versioning boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets the ClawHub-to-OpenClaw product and compatibility boundary, making the cross-project direction owner the best available decision route.
